chunks: Yet, remember, as We communed with Moses for forty nights you took the calf in his absence (and worshipped it), and you did wrong.
ai.seo_question: What happened to the Children of Israel while Moses was receiving revelation?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the fragility of faith when divine guidance is temporarily absent, highlighting the Children of Israel's failure to maintain steadfastness during Moses' (AS) forty-day ascension. The term 'ظالمون' (wrongdoers) is interpreted not merely as external transgressors but as those who inflicted spiritual harm upon their own souls by substituting the unseen with the visible idol. This event serves as a cautionary archetype for the Ummah regarding the necessity of inner conviction beyond mere ritual observance.
